proposals.before: Yao studied under his kinsman Yao Nai, cared little for pedantic textual scholarship, sought the larger meaning, and put it into practice.
proposals.after: Yao studied under his collateral ancestor Yao Nai, cared little for pedantic textual scholarship, sought the larger meaning, and put it into practice.
proposals.reason: 從祖 denotes a collateral paternal ancestor (great-uncle generation), not a generic kinsman.

decisions.reason: s0092 names 總督裕謙; 謙 is qian, so Yuxie misromanizes the personal name, and Yuqian restores the standard reading without changing the rest of the sentence.
The same 裕謙 appears in the literal English as Yuxie; correcting to Yuqian matches the Chinese name while leaving the surrounding calque intact.
s0093 opens with 裕謙死難; replacing the repeated Yuxie with Yuqian corrects the same misreading of 謙 without altering the rest of the idiomatic sentence.
The literal likewise begins from 裕謙; Yuqian is the accurate romanization, and the remainder already tracks 死難…遣戍伊犁…林則徐…屯田…水利…赦還.
瑩師事從祖鼐 uses 從祖, a specific collateral paternal-ancestor kinship term, not a vague kinsman; collateral ancestor Yao Nai restores that sense and matches the unit’s literal.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows Yuxie was invented by the bad romanization of 裕謙; s0092 supports only Yuqian, already claimed in c0103.
